crew.overview: In early-1970s Las Vegas, Sam "Ace" Rothstein gets tapped by his bosses to head the Tangiers Casino. At first, he's a great success in the job, but over the years, problems with his loose-cannon enforcer Nicky Santoro, his ex-hustler wife Ginger, her con-artist ex Lester Diamond and a handful of corrupt politicians put Sam in ever-increasing danger.
crew.title: Casino

crew.overview: Jaded ex-CIA operative John Creasy reluctantly accepts a job as the bodyguard for a 10-year-old girl in Mexico City. They clash at first, but eventually bond, and when she's kidnapped he's consumed by fury and will stop at nothing to save her life.
crew.title: Man on Fire

crew.overview: Dominic Toretto is a Los Angeles street racer suspected of masterminding a series of big-rig hijackings. When undercover cop Brian O'Conner infiltrates Toretto's iconoclastic crew, he falls for Toretto's sister and must choose a side: the gang or the LAPD.
crew.title: The Fast and the Furious

crew.overview: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.
crew.title: Magnolia

details.biography: Dana Kristen Vahle (born Dirk Kevin Vahle) is an American pilot and aerial coordinator for the motion picture and television industry. She is a former United States Army aviator that went ont to fly helicopters, airplanes and seaplanes in private aviation. She joined the Screen Actors Guild in 1985 after being hired to work on the television series Airwolf.
details.name: Dana Kristen Vahle
